answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. This is why the honest majority can be small yet decisive: each vote carries the weight of verifiable work, not just the noise of a large flock.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a tundra as the anchor of the cost.
